measurements.method: Median of paired window ratios and deltas. 20,000 independent-window bootstrap resamples with replacement, percentile 95% interval, xorshift32 initial seed 0x20261003. Three cold build pairs and five runtime/phase windows; no inner sample is treated as an independent window. OS page cache was not flushed. RSS is the maximum reported by /usr/bin/time, not a sum over concurrent children.
measurements.conditions: Serialized local experiments on macOS arm64 with ordinary desktop background activity; CPU/load observations retained. No dedicated-machine or uncontended-host claim.
